integrity_notes: The theorem has a self-contained all-order proof and an exact-rational finite-order checker. Finite checks are corroborative and do not prove unbounded quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic homogeneous complete-simplicial infinite-population mean-field equation only.
Does not assert finite-population stochastic endemic stationary distributions.
No extension to heterogeneous networks, discrete-time updating or noisy measurements is established.
Possible equivalent specialized results in unindexed literature remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp maximal endemic multistability at every simplicial interaction order
